Disable LBR virtualization if the CPU doesn't support callstacks
were introduced in HSW (see commit e9d7f7cd97c4 (""perf/x86/intel: Add
basic Haswell LBR call stack support"")
the perf LBR event with PERF_SAMPLE_BRANCH_CALL_STACK
virtualization always fails on pre-HSW CPUs.
Simply disable LBR support on such CPUs
there is no risk of breaking an existing setup
to performantly context switch LBRs on old CPUs is not worth the effort.
